title: Inkundla yesihlabathi kaLesedi
description: Kuyiphupho likaLesedi ukuya olwandle. Ufuna ukuzwa isihlabathi izinyaweni zakhe futhi akhe nenqaba yesihlabathi. Ngakhoke abazali bakhe baqhamuka neqhinga.
